title: 第4章 战陆家老祖第5章 打造女帝全属性
content_zh:
“老祖当心，他是邪帝！”陆家家主此刻喊了出来。早认出少年是邪帝，给陆家家主一万个胆子他都不敢出手。
“呵，暗王领域！无限黑暗。”邪帝收起狮牙拳套，张开结界，将陆家老祖笼罩在结界之内，以免造成大规模的破坏，毕竟可是神境对拼。
邪帝抬起双手，张开双掌，从手心中发射出黑暗能量，背后出现8个柱状黑色气体，冲向陆家老祖，狂轰乱炸。陆家老祖面对来势汹汹的攻击，还没反应过来，只能被迫防御。
“暗龙毁天诀。形龙首，化龙爪，恶龙出，魔龙附，邪龙降世。”
邪帝收起【无限黑暗】，只见背后涌出一道黑色龙影，8个柱状黑色气体幻化成了8条龙影。九龙背脊！九条黑色龙影面色狰狞，“吼——！”九声龙吟响彻九天圣殿。
“什么？你......你......你你是邪帝！”陆啸看着将自己踩在脚下的少年，充满了畏惧。
在场的人得知少年是邪帝后，都露出了崇拜的神色，这位可是在九天神国有传奇故事的人，一时之间，各家向新来的小辈诉说邪帝的传奇。
邪帝！九天神国的小辈除了归来之人，谁没听说过杀神邪帝。
6岁击败万宇宙三主神之一黑暗神，获封神位，直接从武神境巅峰晋级至神境巅峰。
8岁击败剑圣——圣天极剑，获封剑圣之名。
10岁击杀刀皇——辽一，获封刀皇之名。
13岁千万人围剿一人，千万人皆被屠杀，没有活口，宇宙中人称他为杀神。
一年前，从恶女皇手中夺回九天神国，可谓是九天神国的英雄；一个人灭杀宇宙第一组织星际联盟。
邪帝并没有继承神位，让上一任黑暗神退休，故仍可以行走世间。
“哪怕你是邪帝，我们二人也可以扒你一层皮！陆家不是好欺负的！”
“切。”来自邪帝的蔑视。
陆家两位老祖乃是双胞胎，配合极其默契，同时杀向邪帝。“裂山掌！”
“双龙绞！”两发【裂山掌】，邪帝背后双龙齐出迎击，阻挡了下来。
“四龙翻江，五龙搅海，六龙地动，七龙山摇。”邪帝一口气连发四招。但都被陆家家主勉强防住了。邪帝脚从陆啸身上抬开，缓步走向陆家两位老祖，“就这？老祖就那么点本事嘛？”
“复仇火焰！”邪帝身上燃起黑色的火焰。全身充斥着荒芜死亡的气息，地狱的火焰熊熊燃烧，给人一种心悸之感。神魂！跟战铠齐名，但比觉醒战铠更加困难，拥有神魂的人少之又少。陆家老祖交换眼神，从不同方向发起进攻，但邪帝也冲向一名陆家老祖。

“复仇七星拳。”一颗拳头，幻裂出六颗，七星拳直接轰去，速度极快。
那位陆家老祖身前升起一面石墙，挡住了邪帝的七拳。邪帝身后另一位陆家老祖【裂山掌】，“呵，复仇炸弹。”邪帝在即将被击中那一刻，自爆了。
“嘭——”强大的爆炸，直接震伤了两位老祖。
黑色微粒重塑身形，邪帝的身躯重新凝聚。毫发无损！
“八龙齐出憾山河！”邪帝身后八条龙影同时冲击，陆家老祖还未反应过来，直接被击中。
“九龙齐出啸天地！”又是一招，九条龙影，爆炸声，两位陆家老祖同时倒飞出去，气息萎靡，连战铠都还没来得及召唤，甚至许多底牌也用不出来了。完全就是一面倒的碾压。
“就这本事啊，我还以为有多强呢，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！”邪帝收起九龙与神魂，站在九天圣殿中央。对付他们，邪帝连三成力量都没使出。
“邪帝，为了一个死人的父母你至于在九天圣殿大打出手吗？！你还不住手吗？执法堂的人马上就会来，九天圣殿不允许侵犯！”陆家家主吼道。
“闭嘴！你再敢说一句话，我今晚让你这一脉从陆家除名！还有执法堂的人不敢来管我邪帝的事！除非他们和你们一样蠢！”对于执法堂，邪帝充满了不屑。
九天神国唯有神君可与邪帝抗衡。
“就你刚刚一来就生气是吧？末日审判！”邪帝一脚燃着地狱火直接踢向神境后期陆家老祖的丹田处。
“啊——！！”那位陆家老祖惨叫一声，修为被毁，身上燃起了地狱的黑色火焰。邪帝响指一打，陆家老祖顷刻间尸骨无存，消散于天地之间，就此陨落。
另一位陆家老祖屁也不敢放一个，那可是他的亲弟弟啊！但邪帝不是他可以对付的。一开始出手属实还是上头了。
content_en:
"Be careful, ancestor, he is the evil emperor!" The head of the Lu family shouted at this moment. He had long recognized that the young man was the Evil Emperor, and even if he gave the head of the Lu family ten thousand courages, he would not dare to take action.
"Oh, the Dark King's Realm! Infinite darkness." The Evil Emperor put away the Lion Fang Gloves, opened the barrier, and enveloped the ancestors of the Lu family within the barrier to avoid causing large-scale destruction. After all, this was a battle in the divine realm.
The Evil Emperor raised his hands, opened his palms, and fired dark energy from his palms. Eight pillars of black gas appeared behind him, rushing towards the Lu family ancestor and bombarding him wildly. Facing the menacing attack, the ancestor of the Lu family had not yet reacted and was forced to defend.
"The Dark Dragon Destruction Technique. It takes the form of a dragon head, transforms into a dragon claw, the evil dragon emerges, the evil dragon possesses it, and the evil dragon descends into the world."
The Evil Emperor put away [Infinite Darkness], and saw a black dragon shadow emerging from behind, and 8 columnar black gases transformed into 8 dragon shadows. The back of Kowloon! The nine black dragon shadows looked ferocious, "Roar——!" Nine dragon roars resounded throughout the Nine Heavens Temple.
"What? You...you...you are the Evil Emperor!" Lu Xiao looked at the young man who stepped on him, full of fear.
After the people present learned that the boy was the Evil Emperor, they all showed expressions of admiration. This man had a legendary story in Jiutian Divine Kingdom. For a while, every family told the new generation about the legend of the Evil Emperor.
Evil Emperor! Except for those who have returned, no one in the younger generation of Jiutian Divine Kingdom has heard of the God-killing Evil Emperor.
At the age of 6, he defeated the Dark God, one of the three main gods of the universe, and was granted the title of god. He was directly promoted from the peak of the Martial God realm to the peak of the God realm.
At the age of 8, he defeated the Sword Master, the Holy Tianji Sword, and was awarded the title of Sword Master.
At the age of 10, he killed the Sword Emperor, Liao Yi, and was awarded the title of Sword Emperor.
At the age of 13, tens of millions of people surrounded and suppressed one person, and tens of millions of people were massacred, leaving no one alive. People in the universe called him the God of Killing.
A year ago, he took back the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom from the Evil Queen. He was a hero of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom; he killed the Interstellar Alliance, the number one organization in the universe, by one man.
The Evil Emperor did not inherit the throne and let the previous Dark God retire, so he can still walk the world.
"Even if you are the Evil Emperor, the two of us can still skin you! The Lu family is not someone to be bullied!"
"Tch." Contempt from the Evil Emperor.
The two ancestors of the Lu family were twins, and they worked together extremely well to kill the Evil Emperor at the same time. "Mountain Split Palm!"
"Double Dragon Choke!" After two shots of [Mountain Splitting Palm], the two dragons behind the Evil Emperor came out to attack and blocked him.
"Four dragons overturned the river, five dragons stirred up the sea, six dragons shook the earth, and seven dragons shook the mountains." The Evil Emperor fired four moves in a row. But they were all barely guarded by the head of the Lu family. The Evil Emperor lifted his feet away from Lu Xiao and walked slowly towards the two ancestors of the Lu family, "That's it? Is that what the ancestors have?"
"Revenge Flame!" Black flames ignited on the Evil Emperor's body. The whole body is filled with the aura of desolation and death, and the flames of hell are burning, giving people a feeling of heart palpitations. Soul! It is as famous as the battle armor, but it is more difficult than awakening the battle armor, and there are very few people who have the soul. The Lu family ancestors exchanged glances and launched attacks from different directions, but the Evil Emperor also rushed towards a Lu family ancestor.
"Seven Star Fist of Revenge." With one fist, six phantoms burst out, and the Seven Star Fist blasted them away at an extremely fast speed.
A stone wall rose in front of the Lu family ancestor, blocking the Evil Emperor's seven punches. Behind the Evil Emperor, another Lu family ancestor [Split Mountain Palm] said, "Oh, revenge bomb." The Evil Emperor self-destructed at the moment he was about to be hit.
"Bang——" The powerful explosion directly injured the two ancestors.
The black particles reshaped the figure, and the Evil Emperor's body re-condensed. Unscathed!
"Eight dragons attack the mountains and rivers together!" The eight dragon shadows behind the evil emperor charged at the same time. The ancestor of the Lu family was hit directly before he could react.
"Nine dragons come out to roar the world!" Another move, nine dragon shadows, explosions, the two ancestors of the Lu family flew out at the same time, their breath was weak, they didn't even have time to summon their battle armor, and even many of their trump cards couldn't be used. It was a complete one-sided crushing.
"Just this oneDamn it, I thought it was so powerful, hahahahahaha! "The Evil Emperor put away the Nine Dragons and Divine Souls and stood in the center of the Nine Heavens Temple. To deal with them, the Evil Emperor did not even use 30% of his strength.
"Evil Emperor, are you going to fight in the Nine Heavens Temple for the parents of a dead person? ! Why don't you stop? The people from the Law Enforcement Hall will be here soon, and the Jiutian Temple does not allow intrusion! "The head of the Lu family roared.
"Shut up! If you dare to say another word, I will remove your lineage from the Lu family tonight! There are also people from the Law Enforcement Hall who dare not interfere with my Evil Emperor’s affairs! Unless they are as stupid as you! "The Evil Emperor is full of disdain for the Law Enforcement Hall.
In the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom, only the Divine Lord can compete with the Evil Emperor.
"You just got angry when you came here, right? Doomsday judgment! "The evil emperor kicked with hellfire directly towards the dantian of the ancestor of the Lu family in the late divine realm.
"Ah——! ! "The Lu family ancestor screamed, his cultivation was destroyed, and the black flames of hell ignited on his body. The evil emperor snapped his fingers, and the Lu family ancestor's body disappeared in an instant, dissipated between heaven and earth, and died.
The other ancestor of the Lu family didn't dare to fart, that was his biological brother! But the Evil Emperor is not something he can deal with. It was true that the attack at the beginning was over the top.
